youtube.description:
Road too bright at noon? It's not just sunlight, it's glare.

• Sunlight bouncing off roads, water and car glass becomes harsh glare that makes you squint.
• Polarised lenses have a filter that blocks this glare, so roads and water look clearer.
• A child's eye lens is clearer than an adult's, so more UV reaches inside: kids need sun protection too.
• FOE Kids polarised sunglasses: flexible TR90 frames that bend instead of breaking, for ages 4 to 10.
• FOE Kids polarised sunglasses are Buy 1 Get 1 FREE.
